verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own loading docs say you can schedule load jobs and recurring batch data transfers at regular intervals. Dataform, documented as a BigQuery-integrated service, lets users develop and schedule complex transformation workflows with dependency-tree visualization, and pipelines can be managed in Git folders. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduled SQL queries, details on schedule configuration (cron/interval options, programmatic or CLI/API scheduling suited to AI-native users), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
